$doc: CC-SENSE-CUE v1.1 F4 -- named merger rules per language. Two members that collide under the base key (the active voice's own accent) are kind "true"; members that collide only once a rule here is switched on are kind "accent", and the set records which rule(s). Grading and the bonus read "true" only; Impossible reads both. Transforms are implemented in tools/build_collisions.py under the same names. A rule marked pending is computed for review but not applied to the shipped table.

cot-caught.what: AO merges into AA (cot = caught), the low-back merger common across North America

pin-pen.what: EH becomes IH before N or M (pin = pen), Southern US

mary-marry-merry.what: AE and EY become EH before R (Mary = marry = merry)

seseo.what: z and soft c (ce, ci) merge with s; the es-ES (Castilian) voice keeps them apart (S3, Eric 2026-10-16)
seseo.status: declined: kept in the base key, so seseo pairs stay accept-all (Eric, 2026-10-17). Impossible still excludes them, because they are true sets.
